<script>
  // ---- Set your OTHER region link here ----
  const REDIRECT_OTHER = "https://int.radonindia.com/"; //  << replace if needed

  // ===== Header menu JS =====
  const body = document.body;
  const hamburger = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
  const closeMenuBtn = document.querySelector('.close-menu');
  const fullscreenMenu = document.getElementById('fullscreenMenu');

  function closeMenu(){
    body.classList.remove('menu-open');
    fullscreenMenu.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    const hb = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
    if (hb) hb.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
    body.style.overflow = '';
  }
  if (hamburger){
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const expanded = hamburger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !expanded);
      if (!expanded){
        body.classList.add('menu-open');
        fullscreenMenu.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
        body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      } else { closeMenu(); }
    });
  }
  if (closeMenuBtn) closeMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  fullscreenMenu.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if (e.target===fullscreenMenu) closeMenu(); });

  // Optional “scrolled” header style (white background). Comment out if not needed.
  document.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
    const header = document.getElementById('customHeader');
    if (!header) return;
    if (window.scrollY > 50) header.classList.add('scrolled');
    else header.classList.remove('scrolled');
  });

  // ===== Region selector + page offset logic =====
  (function(){
    const bar   = document.getElementById('region-bar-sections--19677827530997__custom_header_rkRkiG');
    const sel   = document.getElementById('region-bar-sections--19677827530997__custom_header_rkRkiG-select');
    const xBtn  = bar ? bar.querySelector('.close') : null;

    const STORAGE = 'preferredRegion';
    const HIDEKEY = 'regionBarHidden';

    // restore defaults
    let saved='', hidden=false;
    try{ saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE) || ''; hidden = (localStorage.getItem(HIDEKEY) === '1'); }catch(e){}
    if (hidden && bar) bar.style.display = 'none';

    const initial = (saved === 'IN' || saved === 'OTHER') ? saved : 'IN';
    if (sel) sel.value = initial;
    document.body.setAttribute('data-region', initial);

    function updateOffsets(){
      const barH = (bar && bar.style.display !== 'none') ? (bar.offsetHeight || 0) : 0;
      const header = document.getElementById('customHeader');
      const headerH = header ? (header.offsetHeight || 0) : 0;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--region-bar-height', barH + 'px');
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-height', headerH + 'px');
      document.body.style.paddingTop = (barH + headerH) + 'px';
    }

    function changeRegion(val){
      try{ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, val); }catch(e){}
      document.body.setAttribute('data-region', val);

      if (val === 'IN'){               // close on India
        if (bar) bar.style.display = 'none';
        try{ localStorage.setItem(HIDEKEY,'1'); }catch(e){}
        setTimeout(updateOffsets, 20);
      } else if (val === 'OTHER'){     // redirect immediately
        if (REDIRECT_OTHER) window.location.href = REDIRECT_OTHER;
      }
    }

    // events
    if (sel) sel.addEventListener('change', e => changeRegion(e.target.value));

    if (xBtn) xBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ if (bar) bar.style.display='none'; try{ localStorage.setItem(HIDEKEY,'1'); }catch(e){} setTimeout(updateOffsets, 20); });

    // init offsets
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateOffsets);
    } else {
      updateOffsets();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateOffsets);
  })();
</script>

  <script>
    (function(){
      const root = document.getElementById('cst-template--19885021069557__collection_showcase_tabs_DLn9Bm');
      if(!root) return;
      const chips = root.querySelectorAll('.cst__chip');
      const leftItems = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.cst__left-item'));
      const panel = root.querySelector('#cst-panel-template--19885021069557__collection_showcase_tabs_DLn9Bm');
      const templates = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.cst__templates template'));

      function setActiveChip(btn){
        chips.forEach(c=>{
          const active = c === btn;
          c.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
          c.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
      }

      function filterLeftByTab(tabKey){
        leftItems.forEach(item=>{
          item.hidden = item.getAttribute('data-tab') !== tabKey;
          item.classList.remove('is-active');
          item.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');
        });
        const firstVisible = leftItems.find(i=>!i.hidden);
        if(firstVisible){
          firstVisible.classList.add('is-active');
          firstVisible.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
          swapToBlock(firstVisible.getAttribute('data-block-id'));
        }else{
          panel.innerHTML = '<div class="cst__empty">No collections in this tab.</div>';
        }
      }

      function swapToBlock(blockId){
        const tpl = templates.find(t=>t.id === 'tpl-'+blockId);
        if(!tpl){ panel.innerHTML = '<div class="cst__empty">Nothing to show.</div>'; return; }
        panel.innerHTML = '';
        panel.appendChild(tpl.content.cloneNode(true));
        if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 992px)').matches) {
          panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      }

      root.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
        const btn = e.target.closest('.cst__left-item');
        if(!btn) return;
        if(btn.hidden) return;
        leftItems.forEach(b=>{ b.classList.remove('is-active'); b.setAttribute('aria-selected','false'); });
        btn.classList.add('is-active'); btn.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
        swapToBlock(btn.getAttribute('data-block-id'));
      });

      chips.forEach(ch=>{
        ch.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
          setActiveChip(ch);
          filterLeftByTab(ch.getAttribute('data-tab'));
        });
        ch.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
          if(e.key==='Enter' || e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); ch.click(); }
        });
      });

      const initialChip = root.querySelector('.cst__chip.is-active') || chips[0];
      if (initialChip) {
        setActiveChip(initialChip);
        filterLeftByTab(initialChip.getAttribute('data-tab'));
      }
    })();
  </script>
